description: The file defines a Flutter widget library for displaying image thumbnails with customizable cache settings and sizing logic. It includes classes for computing physical pixel sizes for cache decoding, a thumbnail widget that handles network, asset, or file images, and utilities for layout and rendering optimization.

classes.name: ThumbnailSize
classes.description: Encapsulates cache dimensions (width and height) in physical pixels for thumbnails.

classes.name: ThumbnailProvider
classes.description: Computes cache sizes based on layout constraints, device pixel ratio, and aspect ratio to optimize image decoding.

classes.name: Thumbnail
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders an image thumbnail from network, asset, or file source with size and cache management.

methods.name: computeFromConstraints
methods.description: Calculates cache width and height from layout constraints, device pixel ratio, and optional aspect ratio, with snapping and clamping.

methods.name: _clampAndSnap
methods.description: Clamps a value between min and max physical pixels and snaps to nearest multiple.
